strategy: Mono-Black removal-midrange with Gauntlet of Power big-mana payoffs (Nantuko Shade, Howl from Beyond) and a Zombie/sacrifice-value subtheme
identity: Black removal-forward midrange leaning on Zombie/sacrifice value (Cackling Fiend, Necrosavant, Undead Gladiator, Zombie Infestation) with Nantuko Shade and Howl from Beyond converting Gauntlet of Power doubled Swamp mana into damage, Yawgmoth as a sacrifice-engine finisher, and Vampiric Tutor for consistency.
